notes: Full sequence: 1) python3 -c 'import pty;pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'  2) Ctrl+Z to background  3) stty raw -echo; fg  4) press Enter, then export TERM=xterm. Get your local size with stty size and mirror it with stty rows/columns for correct wrapping in less/vim.

recommended.note: Fetch files using an installed scripting interpreter (check with: which python3 python perl ruby php) when wget/curl are unavailable.

name: Upgrade Dumb Shell to Full TTY
description: Turn a non-interactive reverse shell into a fully interactive TTY so you get tab-completion, arrow keys, job control (Ctrl+C/Ctrl+Z) and can run interactive tools like su, ssh and vim. Run the spawn, background with Ctrl+Z, fix the local terminal, then foreground.

variations.label: script
variations.description: Bash reverse shell one-liner. Target connects back to your listener - works through NAT and most firewalls.

variations.label: stty (full steps)
variations.command:
python3 -c 'import pty;pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'
# Ctrl+Z
stty raw -echo; fg
# then in the shell:
export TERM=xterm; stty rows 38 columns 116
